changelog:
* **fix: add description to draft discard dialog** (a741654)
  - Add a confirmation description naming the draft being discarded.
  - Fall back to a generic draft name when the draft is missing.
  - Drop trailing periods from two settings detail dialog sentences.
* **fix: notes dialog stretched look** (3c560d1)
  - Revert notes dialog to standard Material3 AlertDialog so it keeps the
    compact default size instead of stretching.
  - Material3 1.4.0 already dismisses on back press and outside tap, so the
    discard confirmation still appears for both.
  - Keep auto keyboard focus on the note field.
  - Rename discard message to "The note dialog will be discarded".
